from tools import search_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_hotels, filter_restaurants, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Retrieve previous hotel search results
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Retrieve previous restaurant search results
restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Filter hotels based on user's amenity preferences (gym and laundry service)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    has_laundry_service=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Filter restaurants based on user's cuisine and rating preferences
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=restaurants,
    cuisine=["Romanian"],
    rating=[3.5, 5.0]
)

# Save filtered restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)
